{{Quote|More meddling in my affairs. This is beyond tiresome, 'Zenith'.|Darth Lachris, to Zenith|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Zenith''' was the codename of a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorran]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who had made a career out of hurting the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] presence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Biography==
[[File:Zenith.png|thumb|left|200px|Zenith]]
Zenith had been a part of a resistance cell on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], until [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] infiltrated the cell, and shut it down. He then traveled Balmorra, recruiting members to carry out their own guerrilla tactics against the Imperials occupying their [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. After years of this, Zenith gained a hatred towards the Empire, especially [[Darth Lachris]] the Sith's [[Governor/Legends|governor]], and became paranoid as well. He hated seeing fellow Balmorran citizens work with the Empire, and would often deny aid to citizens who did so. After all that Zenith had gone through with the [[Balmorran resistance]] he felt that he may be able to ensure that Balmorra remains free, once the Empire is no longer occupying the planet.

Zenith would later run in the election for the leader of the opposition to [[Tai Cordan]]. He gained the support of Secretary [[Varram]] and managed to beat [[Nalan Fiskin]] in the elections by releasing incriminating information about him found in the [[Gray Star]]'s journals and by convincing Balmorran refugees on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to return home and participating in the elections, gaining the necessary extra votes. However, he performed his duties from [[the Barsen'thor's Defender-class light corvette]].

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught}}
[[File:Zenith_on_Balmorra.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Zenith fighting on Balmorra]]
Years later in [[3626 BBY]]<ref name="Date2">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref>, following the [[Eternal Empire conquest|Zakuulan Conquests]], the rise and fall of the [[Eternal Alliance]], the start of the [[third Galactic War]], and the creation of [[Task Force Nova]], [[Lana Beniko]] informed the [[Alliance Commander]] of a shipment of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] being produced on Balmorra that were to be shipped to a Republic base on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. However, the Empire had found out about the shipment, and intended to ambush it. Beniko suggested that the Alliance contact Zenith, who had been at odds with the Empire for years, and work with him to ensure that the shipment made its way to Corellia undeterred.<ref name="Conflicting Priorities">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Conflicting Priorities|Odessen}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
He is a companion to the [[Jedi Consular]]. He resides on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. In-game, he functions as a ranged DPS, wielding [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]].

He is voiced by [[Troy Baker]], who also voiced SIS agent [[Theron Shan]] in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']], [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] and [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']].

In game update 6.2.1 for [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']], Lana Beniko discusses a shipment of turbolasers being produced on Balmorra for a Republic base on Corellia with the player. If the player character is an Imperial, the conversation is slightly different than how it is for Republic players. Instead of Lana suggesting bringing Zenith in to help protect the shipment, she suggests tricking Zenith into believing that the shipment is actually intended for the Empire, thus setting him upon it.<ref name="Conflicting Priorities" />
